title: Exponent rules
subject: Math
learningGoal: Apply product, quotient, and power rules for exponents.
spokenLines: Three main exponent rules to remember.
Product rule: same base, add the exponents.
Quotient rule: same base, subtract the exponents.
Power rule: power of a power, multiply the exponents.
Example: x to the third, times x to the fifth, is x to the eighth.
x to the seventh over x squared is x to the fifth.
x squared, all raised to the third, is x to the sixth.
That's it. Add, subtract, multiply — depending on the operation.
